messages:
arjun: Quick async standup — kernel + KV perf. Landed a prefetch tweak on the kernel branch (kernel-v2-prefetch). Ran microbatch bench on staging and seeing a p95 reg on 512-token runs. What I did / blockers / today:

ciara: which staging canary? dev/staging/prod?

arjun: staging (kernel-v2-prefetch). Bench command I ran: ```./bench --model gptq64 --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --runs 50```
Results (raw): p50 42ms, p95 238ms, p99 410ms.

kevin: that p95 jump is concerning. Did you try disabling continuous batching to isolate?

arjun: yep — with batching off p95 dropped to ~180ms. Logs show a KV miss spike around the same timeframe (kv.miss count + burst of evictions).

sylvia: were you running the usual KV warmup? we have `scripts/kv_warmup.sh` for the canaries.

arjun: ran warmup, but eviction rate climbed after ~1k requests. suspect threshold too low for new prefetch access pattern. Also saw extra memcpy in path `copy_kv_to_gpu` in the timeline.

ciara: i can bump the eviction threshold on staging canary. i'll set `kv.max_entries=1200000` and re-run — give me 30m.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: kernel-v2-prefetch -> staging (triggered by arjun).

kevin: opened a CR with a memcpy optimization + histograms: PR #4321. tagged @sophie for review. should help the memcpy pain.

arjun: blocker: need green bench with warmup + new threshold before merging the prefetch change. also need a quick review on the prefetch patch (pinging @kevin).

kevin: reviewing PR #4321 now. will push comments if anything blocks. if green bench numbers, i'll merge and cut a canary.

ciara: warmup pass complete after threshold bump. new numbers: p50 44ms, p95 192ms, p99 370ms. uploading raw run to s3: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal/bench/1761239999.json :thumbsup:

arjun: awesome — that looks much better. can you paste the bench command + exact env vars you used?

ciara: command: `./bench --model gptq64 --seq 512 --concurrency 8 --runs 50 --warmup 1000`
env: `KV_MAX_ENTRIES=1200000 KERNEL_PREFETCH=true CONT_BATCH=false`

kevin: noted a small memory growth during warmup on one machine: /var/log/runtime/heap.log shows +50MB per 10k requests. might be a minor leak in the warmup path — i'll add a small fix to the PR.

sophie: quick note — i left review comments on PR #4321 about histogram buckets and an edge-case for seq<64. nothing blocking.

arjun: thanks — i'll address the seq edge-case and re-run the 256/512 sweep.

ciara: i'll run the 256-run now and post results in ~20m.

kevin: FYI i also added a datadog alert for kv.evictions > 1000/min so we can catch thrash earlier. might trigger during rollout.

sylvia: heads-up: telemetry briefly flapped earlier while you were testing, added a note in the incidents channel but nothing systemic.

arjun: plan for today: (1) fix seq-edge in prefetch patch, (2) re-run 256/512 microbench with warmup + bumped kv, (3) verify dd thresholds and merge if numbers stable. ETA ~2 hours.

ciara: update: 256 run finished — p50 28ms, p95 115ms, p99 210ms. attaching raw: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal/bench/1761239999-256.json

arjun: this is great. removing blocker label on the PR after i push the small fix. merging once kevin gives final ack.

deploy-bot: Canary health check: kernel-v2-prefetch on staging -> 5/5 nodes healthy. metrics: cpu 42% mem 67% kv.evictions 12/min.

kevin: final ack posted, merging after CI.

arjun: thanks team — will follow up in a short post-merge run and drop the final numbers here.

ciara: nice work. :party_parrot:

arjun: quick follow-up note: leaving a short repro note in docs/ops (internal) and will create a follow-up ticket for improving warmup coverage.
